HOW EVERY CASE WORKS

Four steps. Every time.

  1. STEP 01

    The Theory

    What do people say happened? You hear it the way its fans tell it.

  2. STEP 02

    The Evidence

    Reports, memos, tapes and sworn words, with sources you can check.

  3. STEP 03

    Both Sides

    The best case for it. The best case against it. Side by side.

  4. STEP 04

    You Decide

    No verdict from me. The last step is yours.

THE BOOKS

Go deeper than a video can

Each case file starts as a book by JR Korvus. The videos are the short version. The books hold the full story and the sources.

Coming soon

Conspiracy Theory: Two Words That Changed the World

Two men each believed powerful people were hiding a crime. One was right and helped end a 40-year medical scandal. The other was wrong and walked into a pizza shop with a rifle. This book follows the strange history of conspiracy theories and asks how to tell a real cover-up from a false story.

About this book

Coming soon

The Paperclip Secret

In 1969 the world cheered as a giant rocket carried men to the Moon. Few knew that some of the men behind it had run a Nazi rocket factory where thousands of prisoners died. This book shows how their pasts were hidden, and how the truth finally came out.

About this book

Coming soon

Case Never Closed

No one was ever put on trial for killing President Kennedy. The only man charged was shot dead two days later. This book uses the government's own released papers to show what was hidden, how it was hidden, and why the case never closed.

About this book

The Evidence Checklist

  1. Who is making the claim?
  2. Can I see the source myself?
  3. Is it a fact, a guess or an opinion?
  4. What would prove it wrong?
  5. What does the other side say?

... and 5 more.
